segment_text: SECTION 8.14. Amendments. No provisions of this Agreement shall be deemed waived, amended, supplemented or modified by any Party hereto, unless such waiver, amendment, supplement or modification is in writing and signed by the authorized representative of each Party.
span_text: No provisions of this Agreement shall be deemed waived, amended, supplemented or modified by any Party hereto, unless such waiver, amendment, supplement or modification is in writing and signed by the authorized representative of each Party.
annotator_notes:
Carve-out recorded verbatim per section 8.2: 'unless such waiver, amendment, supplement or modification is in writing and signed by the authorized representative of each Party.' As annotated the obligation is deliberately STRONGER than the contract's -- a flat prohibition where the document permits waiver in signed writing. Three judgment calls, reviewer-approved: (1) 'waived, amended, supplemented or modified' read as ONE obligation with a compound near-synonymous action, not 4 chained obligations, so section 2's 4+ exclusion does not fire; only WAIVE exists in the 34-verb taxonomy. (2) span_text includes the unless clause though the fields encode the carve-out-free reading. (3) obligor 'any Party' is generic and will also return UNRESOLVED_PARTY from typecheck(), so this item exercises two gaps at once.

RESTAMPED AT GUIDELINE v0.48 (section 10.1 F8, ruled at section 8.3.2 in v0.47; the restamp was deliberately deferred to this freeze-pass batch). GAINS TWO TAGS, NOT ONE -- this item carried only ['exception_unsupported'] and now carries all THREE that section 8.3.2 requires: compound_action, action_not_in_taxonomy, exception_unsupported. Section 10.1's F8 row said 'gains action_not_in_taxonomy (3 tags total)'; the parenthetical total was right and the verb phrase was incomplete, because compound_action had never been applied to this item either. Both are added, and the discrepancy is recorded rather than quietly reconciled. THE RULING: the span reads 'No provisions of this Agreement shall be deemed WAIVED, AMENDED, SUPPLEMENTED OR MODIFIED by any Party hereto'. WAIVE is a taxonomy member; AMEND, SUPPLEMENT and MODIFY are not, verified against compiler/ast.py's real ACTIONS, and none is defensibly mappable to WAIVE -- amending a provision and waiving one are different legal acts. Section 8.3 branch 3 therefore applies on its letter: a dropped verb outside the taxonomy entirely is genuinely lost, so BOTH compound_action (the verb bundle IR v1's single action field cannot hold) and action_not_in_taxonomy (the dropped verbs have no home in the 34-verb list) fire; section 8.3's own branch 3 says both apply and that section 9's per-tag counts are non-summable. Branch 2's SPIRIT was genuinely arguable -- both annotators independently described the chain as one act-type -- and was REJECTED because branch 2 states that intuition as a mechanical mapping test, and extending it to a 'feels like a legal doublet' judgment would trade a checkable boundary for an unfalsifiable one. SECTION 9 DENOMINATOR: unaffected -- this item already carried exception_unsupported, so len(known_gaps) was already non-zero. CASSETTE: segment E01-047 IS recorded (3 runs), so this restamp is a genuine section 22 conforming event and those cassettes go stale on the guideline_version staleness dimension. Accepted deliberately as part of the freeze-pass batch, not discovered afterwards. Original v0.28 annotation preserved above unedited.
